why: Flattens the role cue's raised mine block to the painted deck bar under reduced motion, so the mine-load cue changes shape with a preference that is about movement, not about what a tank carries. Issue #1018 asks that the cue's geometry be identical under either preference at rest. Killed by the case that builds grey, olive and teal with `both` under each preference and compares every cue part's vertices and world matrix.
killedBy: the role cue under reduced motion (issue #1018) builds the same hull, turret, barrel, flare and mine block either way, at rest -- population: 3 kinds
